title: Deleted items must be distinguished from temporarily unavailable items in availability queries
gherkin:
Feature: Availability State Semantics Separation
  Scenario: Deleted items are semantically distinct from temporarily unavailable items
    Given an item that has been deleted from the system
    When the availability query is executed
    Then the response must indicate the item is permanently non-operational
    And the response must NOT use the same wording as temporarily blocked items
    And the response must clearly indicate the item is not recoverable
rationale: E5 documents that availability query API surfaces deleted records using the same wording as temporarily blocked items, misleading users about recoverability. This test ensures deleted items are semantically separated from temporary unavailability.
